lessons.text: When import path issues prevent tests from locating project modules, configure sys.path directly within permitted test files rather than creating or modifying repository-level files like conftest.py or root __init__.py.

Do not remove test environment or path-configuration files (such as conftest.py) required for module resolution out of speculative scope concerns. Verify whether project guidelines actually forbid configuration files before deleting working fixes that enable test execution.
When tests fail with FileNotFoundError, inspect the traceback to identify the exact path or operation that failed instead of assuming the implementation file was missing or reverted.
When tests fail with errors like FileNotFoundError, inspect the full traceback to identify the exact line raising the exception instead of assuming the environment failed to persist files.
